variants.prompt: In the dimly lit foyer of an upscale Berlin nightclub, Astrid leans against a sleek, black wall, her form barely illuminated by the pulsing strobe lights. Clad in a sheer, long-sleeved top that leaves little to the imagination, she crosses one leg over the other, the curve of her thigh on full display. Her eyes are half-lidded, a coy smile playing on her lips as she meets the viewer's gaze directly, an invitation to the forbidden pleasures within.
